cases.title: Golden case CHG-1042: unrecognized $2,840 Northstar Equipment charge, investigated to credit, dispute, controls and close
Investigation extracts the $440 overcharge, the 1-vs-2 unit mismatch and the missing receipt, all cited
Follow-up asks only for what is missing (receipt, who placed the order) and waits for the cardholder
Cardholder confirms on the call that she placed and authorized the order: conflicts resolve, policy says ineligible, credit is refused and the case closes with no action
Ambiguous reply with no receipt: reviewed as incomplete, routed to identity verification, receipt still missing
No reply: the deadline watcher marks the request overdue once, the analyst sends one explicit reminder
Related CHG-1051 is a finding on CHG-1042 awaiting review; reviewing it as related changes nothing on CHG-1051
The same charge reported twice links to the existing case: one case, one claim, no second investigation
A reply with a receipt changes the evidence snapshot; policy is re-evaluated on the new snapshot and the old result is no longer current
A corrected delivery record (1 unit) appends version 2, supersedes the quantity conflict and marks the purchase-records check stale
Push verification approved by the cardholder: identity verified, the call is offered next
Push verification declined: recorded as declined (not fraud), the call stays locked and a new request is offered
Three wrong one-time codes lock the request; a fourth attempt is refused, nothing is verified, and staff never see the code
Telephony provider fails once before dispatch: the worker retries the same key and places exactly one call
Voice provider reports the call failed (busy): case goes to call-failed, a second consented call succeeds
The cardholder contradicts herself on the call: the call is recorded as failed, conflicts stay open and policy stays blocked
Voicemail on the first call: recorded, attempt preserved; the retry reaches the cardholder and resolves the conflicts
The provider delivers the same signed transcript webhook twice: one transcript version, one recorded result
A transcript webhook that arrives after the call timed out is recorded as stale and changes nothing
A failure event arriving after the transcript, and an event for an unknown call, never rewind or corrupt the case
A worker claims the investigation job and dies: the job is reclaimed only after the visibility timeout and runs once
The worker crashes after two specialists finished: the checkpointed graph resumes at the receipt review and repeats nothing
A specialist cites a value that is not in the evidence: the output is rejected, nothing is stored, and a replay retry recovers
A specialist tries to read the cardholder's phone number, outside its scope: recorded as a scope violation, nothing stored
Evidence changes after the reviewer approved: the approval goes stale, credit is refused, and a fresh packet and approval issue credit exactly once
Evidence changes while the approval request waits: the reviewer's approve is refused as stale and nothing moves money
Reviewer rejects the credit decision with a reason: returned to the analyst, credit refused, packet kept
Packet prepared while a related charge still awaits review: policy needs evidence, so approval cannot be requested and credit cannot run
Credit adapter fails before dispatch: nothing is issued; the analyst's retry issues exactly one credit under the same key
Credit result lost in transit (uncertain): the case waits in credit check, re-issue is refused, lookup confirms one credit
Dispute submission result uncertain: resolved by lookup without resending the dispute
Card admin declines the proposed controls: nothing is applied and apply is refused; the dispute track continues
Closing while the dispute, controls and final message are open is refused; the checklist names the open items
Investigation ends unresolved: no credit, no dispute, final message sent and the case closes
Analyst tries reviewer and card-admin commands: every one is refused as role_forbidden and nothing is written
Cardholder tries analyst actions and staff reads: refused, and the cardholder sees no internal data
Dana holds reviewer and card-admin roles: while acting as reviewer she cannot approve or apply card controls
Asking Vera in chat to approve the credit is refused with a pointer to the reviewer action; nothing is written
An executable attached to the reply is rejected; the request stays open and nothing is stored
A 10 MB + 1 byte attachment is rejected by the schema; nothing is stored and the cardholder can still reply
The same command sent twice with the same key replays the first result; a different payload under that key is refused
Issue credit posted three times with the server key: one credit, one adapter call, later attempts replay
A published workflow version cannot be edited through commands or directly in the database; the case stays pinned to v3
Hold mid-investigation blocks money actions; resume re-derives the exact step from stored facts
Telephony keeps failing: after the worker's retries the call is recorded as incomplete, the case leaves 'in progress' and a new call is offered
A non-material re-key of the purchase order appends a version but does not stale the approval: credit proceeds once
Reply reviewed as complete while purchase-record conflicts are open: no credit, decision recorded, but closure stays refused because only a verification call resolves conflicts

mutations.breaks: the gateway no longer checks the active role against the command (stage 1)
commands that need an eligible policy result run without one (stage 7)
a repeated idempotency key is processed again instead of replayed (stage 3)
specialist findings are stored without checking their cited values

baseline.description: Single-pass baseline: one agent (the Charge Investigator's reference output) whose findings are stored after schema validation only. Vera: three investigation specialists whose findings must pass the grounding validator. Measured on the reference recordings and the synthetic seed; no model is called.

rows.basis: reference recordings vs the 4 CHG-1042 facts
conflict findings in the investigation output
4 perturbations of each reference citation; schema-only vs validate_grounding
false positives of the validator on the reference output

missed_by_baseline: related charge CHG-1051 at the same merchant
not_compared: Next-question quality: no single-pass follow-up exists in the code to compare; Vera's follow-up is checked deterministically (EC-03: at most 2 questions, asks for the receipt, never re-asks supported items).
Safe routing: a single-pass agent with direct adapter access has no gate to measure; Vera's gates are measured instead by the forbidden-command probes in this report.
Recovery: the code has no non-checkpointed mode to run; Vera's resume is measured in EC-21 and EC-22 (no specialist step repeated after a timeout or crash).

known_limitations: All cases run on the single synthetic seed (CHG-1042 and its related records). Variation comes from commands, demo seams (material change, adapter faults, call outcomes, deadline watcher) and scripted specialist turns, not from a corpus of distinct customers.

Specialists run in REPLAY from reference recordings. A case that needs the model to say something else (a voicemail, a contradicted call) overrides that turn with an 'eval-scripted' recording; it still passes through the same loop and validators. Live model quality is not measured by this suite.

Where a stale approval moves the case to decision_pending/stale, a credit attempt is refused by the step gate first; the approval-binding gate behind it is exercised directly in tests/integration/test_decisions.py.

A 'dispute' decision goes straight to the dispute track without reviewer approval; the dispute is gated by the analyst-reviewed packet. This is the product's current rule and is recorded, not changed, by this suite.
Webhook cases use the ElevenLabs provider over an in-process mock transport with real signatures; no telephony provider is contacted.
The worker is driven in-process with a synthetic clock (2031-01-01 onward); real concurrency between worker processes is covered by tests/integration/test_worker_graph.py.
The optional LLM judge scores only bounded qualitative text and never runs in CI; it needs NVIDIA_API_KEY and --judge.
